messages:
Maya F: Heads-up — NetBilling invoice #89231 for AcmePilot shows a huge staging environment spike for Feb. They claim a misconfigured data export caused 14M tokens of test traffic. Requesting a one-off credit on staging usage.
Liam S: cc @Sophie D — looks like a churn-risk? customer is small-mid, pilot stage. They asked for a discount to avoid pausing. :thinking_face:
Noah K: How much is the bill and what do they want? I need GL/adj notes for approvals.
Maya F: Invoice total $24,600; staging-specific line item is $9,840. Customer asks for a one-time credit on that line due to config error. They offered to sign a post-pilot commitment if we approve partial relief.
Liam S: Can we do a capped credit tied to an onboarding commit? Sales can commit to 6-mo pilot upsell if we give partial relief.
Sophie D: Quick checklist for Deal Desk: 1) Verified incident (ops ticket or logs) 2) Dollar amount & cap 3) Escalation path if they churn 4) Approval owner and GL code. Do we have ops ticket?
Maya F: ops-bot: link to support ticket
ops-bot: <https://support.redwood.com/ticket/INC-4582|INC-4582> — support created log of the runaway export at 2024-02-12T08:13Z, root cause mis-scheduled ETL.
Maya F: Attaching polyline of token usage snippet: ```staging-usage: 2024-02-12 07:00 -> +14,032,128 tokens
peak qps: 1200
service: staging-worker-3
query: bulk-export.sh``` 
Noah K: Good — ops confirmed. Recommend one-time credit 50% of staging line = $4,920, but cap to $5k and require a signed playbook + onboarding checkpoint in 30 days.
Liam S: Sales accepts that condition. We'll send 30-day playbook and commit note in SFDC.
Sophie D: Approver note: I approve a one-time 50% credit on the staging line, capped at $5,000. Conditions: (1) Customer signs the onboarding commitment addendum (6 months), (2) Sales to log SFDC case with contract addendum, (3) Finance to record GL code ADJ-CR-SYS. I'll forward to billing to process.
Maya F: Thanks @Sophie D — will add to invoice comments and route to billing ops. Can you add the approval memo to this thread for audit?
Sophie D: Added: "Deal Desk approval 2024-02-15: one-time 50% credit on invoice #89231 staging usage, cap $5,000, contingent on signed onboarding addendum and SFDC entry. Approver: Sophie D." :white_check_mark:
Noah K: Finance action: create credit memo CM-2024-0987, GL ADJ-CR-SYS, note "staging usage credit per Deal Desk 2024-02-15". I'll process today.
Liam S: I'll follow up with customer and attach the addendum.
Maya F: Closing loop — customer notified. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
